title: Stepwise tour cards for Console onboarding and in-product education
creator: Maya Chen
description:
Problem: New users and returning engineers are unsure which Console flows to use for cost controls, deployment rollouts, and model pinning. Current empty states and single passive onboarding banners are not surfacing the right next actions for different personas.

Goal: Ship a set of stepwise "tour cards" — compact, contextual micro-guides that appear in empty states and key Console surfaces (Dashboards, Rollouts, Cost views). Each card is a single actionable step (create project, connect billing, enable rollout preview, run a cost simulation) with a short description, an optional micro-template, and a dismiss / snooze policy. The experience should be composable so PMs can author templates for new SSO, Dedicated, or Private customers.

Scope: Design and prototype 6 tour cards across 3 surfaces: Dashboard (project setup, API keys), Rollouts (create canary policy, add fallback model), Cost view (run quick cost simulator, enable cost alerts). Exclude full onboarding flows that require multi-step forms; the cards should surface quick wins or link to a short guided flow.

Constraints: Must respect Console density and not block primary tasks. Cards should be keyboard-accessible, support localization, and telemetry hooks should be defined for cadence decisions (show, snooze, dismiss). Work with Eng to ensure cards are lightweight DOM elements and can be toggled server-side for experiments.
acceptance_criteria: Designs for 6 unique tour cards across Dashboard, Rollouts and Cost pages with responsive states
Figma prototype with clickable flows for show/snooze/dismiss and link-to-guided-flow
Authoring pattern documented for PMs to create new card templates (content, CTA, telemetry tags)
Accessibility checklist completed (keyboard, contrast, screen reader labels)
Handoff token list and CSS spec for engineering implementation
review_notes: PM (Arjun Patel) - prefers cost simulator card to include immediate 'estimate for last 7 days' CTA in addition to guided flow
ENG (Nia Roberts) - requests telemetry hooks: card_shown, card_clicked, card_snoozed, card_dismissed and a server flag to gate rollout
Security (Priya Shah) - notes no sensitive data should appear in cards; ensure KMS/keys CTAs navigate to secure pages only
updates: 2026-03-01: Initial concept sketches completed. Identified three anchor surfaces and 10 candidate micro-actions based on support logs and onboarding interviews.
2026-03-03: Low-fidelity prototypes user-tested with 6 engineers; major finding: prefer single CTA + optional 'why this matters' line. Reduced copy by 40%.
2026-03-06: High-fidelity Figma prototype created and linked. Added snooze for 7/30 days. Accessibility pass started.
2026-03-08: Cross-functional design review. PM requested analytics schema; Eng requested CSS tokens and ARIA labels. Iterated prototype accordingly.
2026-03-10: Submitted design for dev handoff. Created task list for ENG-7921 (implementation spike) and DES-17500 (authoring UI).

Sofia Morales (Design) — Suggest we A/B test compact cards vs full-width banners on the dashboard for conversion to 'create project'.
